# v2.0: vitamins, minerals, fibre, sodium, saturated fat (generated by `src/analysis/v2_report.py`)

EFSA adult reference values (`config/micronutrients.yaml`); cooking losses from USDA raw↔cooked pairs (true-retention method). v1.0 = energy, protein, amino acids, macros and safeguards only.

## 6. Contaminants (reported only; Frida data cover ≈ 50–60 % of foods)

Owner v2.0 diet: mercury 2.0 µg/day (TWI-based daily limit 14.1); cadmium 15.9 µg/day (limit 27.1). Cereal- and legume-heavy diets carry most of the cadmium.
